prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity desktop web app UI mockup, 1536 by 1024, front-on full viewport, no laptop frame or background outside the UI. Product: Outdoor OS, combining trail discovery, trip planning, gear packing, and GPS recording. This is a task-focused app, not a marketing landing page. Direction A: Trailhead workspace, airy and modern.
STRUCTURE: 76px white horizontal header with small evergreen mountain mark and Outdoor OS wordmark on left; four centered nav labels Overview (active), Explore, My trips, Gear; green 'Record activity' button and profile icon right. Page ground very light cool mineral #f6f7f4. 72px side margins. Header below nav reads 'A little closer to outside.' with small subtitle 'Find a trail. Pack with purpose. Make a day of it.' Main upper section is two columns: 65% wide scenic mountain backpacking photograph with slight dark scrim ONLY behind white text, 35% clean white next-trip workspace. Left photograph contains large practical sans headline 'Less planning. More wandering.' and a wide white search field 'Search a trail, park, or place'. Right panel heading 'Your next trip', a small label 'Example trip · Preview', title 'Teton Crest Trail', location 'Wyoming, USA', values '40 mi' and '4 days', understated packing progress '3 of 6 items packed', green button 'Continue planning'. Under the two columns a single horizontal three-part connected workflow with clean thin icons: 'Find your trail', 'Prepare your pack', 'Record your outing'. Below it, a broad left list 'A few paths to consider' with two beautifully spaced rows 'The Enchantments Thru-Hike' 'Washington, USA' '18 mi' and 'Lost Coast Trail' 'California, USA' '25 mi'; right small 'Your time outside' empty state 'Every adventure starts somewhere.' plus 'Record an activity' button.
STYLE: crisp sophisticated professional product typography, Inter-like sans, dark pine #26312c text, muted readable grey-green supporting labels, evergreen #234d3c action buttons, white surfaces, deliberate 12px corner rounding, subtle 1px outlines, no glow, no glass, no gradients except the image readability scrim, no serif, no decorative topographic patterns, no fake ratings/weather/activity totals. Beautiful landscape photography with hikers is the only image. Clear visual hierarchy, high contrast, restrained line icons, practical airy spacing. Render all text cleanly at usable interface sizes. The example trip is explicitly illustrative.
